problem: A constant inflow from the top produces a steady suction profile above a water table at the base. The Brooks–Corey law stays saturated up to its air-entry suction, so the profile has a kink where desaturation begins.
result: Largest pressure error: 18.84 Pa, 1.69% of the profile range.
scope: 2D, 0.025 m mesh, steady state; storage does not enter the steady solution.
meaning: This checks the retention-dependent conductivity and the flux boundary. It does not test transient storage or coupled slope behaviour.
